newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Treasury sees NZ unemployment 6.1 pct by Mar 98. [CORRECTED 04:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Treasury sees NZ unemployment 6.1 pct by Mar 98. [CORRECTED 04:40 GMT]

text.p: New Zealand's Treasury said on Thursday in a pre-election Economic and Fiscal Update that unemployment would rise from the current 6.2 percent to 6.3 percent by March 97.
It said the rate would be 6.1 percent in 1997/98.
It also forecast the current account deficit as a percentage of GDP would rise to 4.5 percent in 1996/97, 4.8 percent in 1997/98, 5.0 percent in 1998/99, and then ease to 4.0 percent in 1999/00.
